description:
Free, open-source desktop organizer that groups icons into frames, mirrors folders, and holds notes and images.

DesktopPossible is a free, open-source Stardock Fences alternative for Windows 10/11. It groups desktop icons into virtual frames, mirrors folders live (Portal frames, with an Explorer-style Details view and filters), and adds Note, Image and live system-info Text frames. Includes workspace profiles with hotkeys and virtual-desktop switching, a one-click desktop categorizer with optional auto-organize, SpotSearch, and theming with a wallpaper-matching Chameleon mode.
